categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in manufacturing automotive interior parts including Cockpit Modules (Crash Pads), Door Trims, and Anti-Vibration Pads. It also produces battery module components for electric vehicles and ESS (Energy Storage System) parts. The business includes domestic supply primarily to Hyundai Motor Company and exports to Europe and the US.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as PSM (Polymer Sheet Molding) processes for new material development and has expertise in injection molding, insert molding, and composite resin formulations. It holds numerous patents related to automotive interior components, battery module housings, and manufacturing methods, emphasizing lightweight and high-strength materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customer is Hyundai Motor Company, with additional business relationships involving Hyundai Mobis and other major Korean automakers. The company serves the automotive industry, focusing on first-tier supply of interior modules and battery components for electric vehicles. It also targets the ESS and BMA (Battery Module Assembly) markets in Europe and the US.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are centered in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Ulsan and overseas subsidiaries in China (Beijing and Chongqing) and the United States. The company exports automotive battery parts to Europe and the US and maintains a presence in the Chinese automotive market through acquisitions and joint ventures.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a first-tier automotive parts supplier, producing modules and components directly for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) like Hyundai. It is positioned downstream in the automotive supply chain, focusing on component manufacturing and assembly for vehicle interiors and battery modules.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in lightweight materials, advanced molding technologies, and battery module design to support electric vehicle development. The company invests in R&D with a dedicated research institute, focusing on new material compositions, manufacturing process improvements, and participation in new car model development with OEMs. It emphasizes quality improvement and system modularization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of manufactured automotive parts and battery components to OEMs under supply contracts. The company’s sales are mostly product-based, including domestic sales to Hyundai and exports of battery parts. Payment terms vary between electronic notes for domestic sales and cash or letter of credit for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other Korean automotive parts suppliers such as Hyundai Mobis and firms associated with GM Korea, Renault Samsung, and SsangYong. It holds a strong position as a key supplier to Hyundai-Kia, benefiting from close collaboration and integration with the OEM. Market share in cockpit modules is significant but exact figures are not disclosed.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.88 trillion KRW, a 21.6% increase from the previous year, driven by new car launches and production volume growth. Operating profit declined by 9.6% to 27.7 billion KRW, and net profit decreased by 61.3% due to increased non-operating expenses. Total assets stood at about 573.6 billion KRW, with a moderate growth trend in sales but pressure on profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced automotive interior modules and battery components with strong OEM collaboration. Its value proposition includes just-in-time delivery, zero customer complaints through quality control, and cost competitiveness via efficient inventory management. Proprietary technologies and extensive patent portfolio support product differentiation in lightweight and high-performance materials.
